summary: All 7 acceptance tests for the Nintendo 3DS homebrew 'TriCord Presence' passed. Full build and clean rebuild both exit 0 producing all required artifacts. ctrtool validates the CXI (title id 000401300f000102, APT:S/fs:USER/soc:U, Memory Type SYSTEM) and the CIA romfs (contains tricord_overlay.3gx, 000401300F000102.cxi, titles.txt). Host gateway test builds and connects to gateway.discord.gg, receives HELLO, sends IDENTIFY, receives expected close code 4004 (invalid token) and exits 0. gen_qr.py produces a single inline <svg> with 434 <rect> elements, no text/script/link nodes. titles.txt has 4206 lines all matching regex, sorted, no duplicates, Mario Kart 7 entry present. 9 TODO(hardware) markers remain (intentional), no literal Discord token hardcoded in C/C++.
critical_code_review_comments: build.sh emits placeholder GitHub URL warning for dist/qr.html — expected behavior, must be re-run with real release URL before shipping.

Clean rebuild output shows some targets 'Nothing to be done' before rebuild — because installer/romfs was populated by prior build; the rm -f + clean sequence still works and rebuilds everything as verified in logs.

Ticket TitleId in the CIA is 000400000f000200 (installer app) while sysmodule TitleId 000401300f000102 is embedded as romfs asset — this is the correct design (installer copies the sysmodule to sdmc:/luma/sysmodules/).
test_credentials: Fake Discord token 'FAKE.TOKEN' used intentionally; close code 4004 is the expected result.
